summary: Radiopharm Theranostics filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a $4.1 million registered direct offering. The company issued 1,281,646 ADSs at $3.16 per ADS, each representing 300 ordinary shares, to institutional investors. In a concurrent private placement, it issued warrants to purchase up to 1,281,646 ADSs at $3.79 per ADS, exercisable after shareholder approval and expiring July 31, 2029. H.C. Wainwright acted as placement agent. The offering was made under an effective shelf registration statement on Form F-3. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation, so no deal terms apply.
